messages.subject: ponytail plan ready: 12 tasks; reflect partial, 2 blocking plan findings
messages.body: worker_status: succeeded; the plan is .dev/tasks/to-do/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181547/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181547.md (12 tasks in 5 phases, every task with acceptance criteria; Task 11 writes INSTALL.md, Task 12 copies T05-T10 and adds the T08a template), it applies the owner decisions and the three rulings, and .dev/tasks is staged. The advisory reflect check (tier 2, report .dev/brainstorms/346-ponytail/workflow-report/nested/reflect-1/REPORT.md) is partial with 2 blocking plan findings left unapplied because reflect never edits the plan: Task 8's line-for-line drift test and its no-src/superclaude test cannot both pass since spec-panel.md:220 contains that string (owner choice needed), and Task 2 records no FR-8/FR-9 protected flag; 7 minor ones include the variant Usage line still offering --unattended and Task 5 missing exit 2 on a disagreeing verdict. Not covered: SPEC sections 5-6 (running the experiment) by scope, the plugin-in-worker smoke dispatch (only an INSTALL.md precondition), and progress.md, which /sc:implement creates on its first run, not /sc:workflow.
